clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Narache, Chief Hawkwind prepares young Shu'halo for the wider world. He guides their traditional rites of passage on Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore, teaching humility, respect for the land, and the strength to protect their people.

Chief Hawkwind prepares young tauren at Camp Narache for life beyond Red Cloud Mesa. On the mesa, fledgling hunters, shamans, druids, and warriors undertake the ancient Rites of the Earthmother. Hawkwind oversees the customs, teaching each youth duty and endurance before they leave the mesa's safety.

Chief Hawkwind begins his lessons with humility, not martial glory. He sends initiates to fetch clean spring water and do other simple chores, teaching reverence for nature and their elders. Once they show humility, braves face tests of martial prowess. Their trials test their resolve against aggressive Bristleback quilboar encroaching on the ancestral plains.

Chief Hawkwind must also face dangers at Camp Narache's doorstep. The Bristleback tribe presses against Red Cloud Mesa's perimeter with growing boldness. Hawkwind coordinates the settlement's defense, sending newly proven braves to blunt quilboar assaults and keep the sacred training grounds secure.
